text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI help workers organise schedules, analyse data, and communicate more effectively. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where people and machines solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear that require different skills. Workers need training to adapt to this new environment. Overall, AI can make work faster and smarter, but it also demands flexibility and continuous learning from everyone involved.
